name: Course Layouts – Elementor Addon for TutorLMS
author: UserElements

sections.description:
Course Layouts – Elementor Addon for TutorLMS is a comprehensive extension that transforms your TutorLMS course display with advanced grid layouts, intelligent filtering, real-time search, and SEO-optimized schema markup through powerful Elementor widgets.

Core Features

  • Course Directory Grid Widget: Display TutorLMS courses in beautiful, customizable grid layouts with extensive styling options
  • Course Categories Grid Widget: Show course categories in responsive grid layouts with customizable appearance
  • Advanced Filtering System: Filter courses by category, level, instructor, tags, price range, rating, and duration
  • Real-time AJAX Search: Instant search functionality with debounced input for optimal performance
  • Multiple Pagination Options: Numbered pagination, load more buttons, and infinite scroll capabilities
  • Responsive Design: Fully responsive layouts that adapt perfectly to desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
  • SEO Schema Markup: Automatic generation of structured data for better search engine visibility
  • Keyboard Navigation: Full keyboard accessibility support for enhanced user experience
  • URL Parameter Support: Filter state preserved in URL for bookmarking and sharing

Widget Features

Course Directory Grid Widget:
* Multiple layout types (grid, list, masonry)
* Customizable columns (1-6 columns with responsive breakpoints)
* Course image display with hover effects
* Course title, excerpt, and meta information display
* Price, rating, duration, and lesson count display
* Instructor information and enrollment count
* Course categories, level, and tags display
* Course benefits and progress indicators
* Extensive styling controls for all elements

Course Categories Grid Widget:
* Responsive category grid layouts
* Category image, title, and description display
* Course count per category
* Customizable styling and hover effects
* Sorting options (name, count, date)

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/course-layouts-elementor-tutorlms directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Ensure both Elementor and TutorLMS are installed and activated
  4. Use the Elementor page builder to add the Course Directory Grid or Course Categories Grid widgets to your pages
  5. Configure the widget settings to match your design requirements and functionality needs
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require TutorLMS?

Yes, this plugin requires TutorLMS to be installed and activated. It extends TutorLMS functionality with advanced course display options and integrates with TutorLMS course data.

Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes, this plugin is designed to work with Elementor page builder. It adds custom widgets to Elementor for displaying courses and categories with advanced functionality.

Can I customize the course grid layout?

Yes, the plugin provides extensive customization options including layout types (grid/list), columns (1-6), spacing, colors, typography, hover effects, and responsive breakpoints.

Does the plugin support filtering and search?

Yes, the plugin includes advanced filtering by category, level, instructor, tags, price, rating, and duration. It also features real-time AJAX search with customizable placeholders.

Is the plugin responsive?

Yes, all layouts are fully responsive with customizable breakpoints for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. The grid automatically adapts to different screen sizes.

Does the plugin support SEO?

Yes, the plugin automatically generates structured data (schema markup) for courses, which helps search engines understand your content and can improve search rankings.

Can I use pagination with the course grid?

Yes, the plugin supports multiple pagination options including numbered pagination, load more buttons, and infinite scroll for better user experience.

Does the plugin work with WooCommerce?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with WooCommerce and supports both free and paid course enrollment through TutorLMS integration.

Can I filter courses by multiple criteria?

Yes, the plugin supports multi-criteria filtering allowing users to combine category, level, instructor, tags, and other filters simultaneously.

Is the plugin accessible?

Yes, the plugin includes keyboard navigation support and ARIA labels for better accessibility compliance.
